sentences.text: ORAL ORDER 1. RULE.
Learned APP waives service of notice of Rule on behalf of the respondent-State.

2. The present application has been filed by the applicant- convict through jail praying to release him on parole leave for a period of 30 days on the ground of engaging of lawyer to prefer an appeal against his conviction.
3. Heard learned APP appearing for the respondent-State and I have gone through the jail record of the applicant- convict.

It appears from the jail record that the applicant- convict was convicted for the offence punishable under NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/9913/2023 ORDER DATED:
18/08/2023 undefined Sections 376(2)(f), 376(2)(n), 201, 350, 312 of the Indian Penal Code as well as Sections 3 and 4 of he Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act and sentenced to undergo 20 years imprisonment.
